newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecel float priced at 7,950 esc/shr.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecel float priced at 7,950 esc/shr.

text.p: The price fixed in the flotation of up to 39.11 percent of Portuguese mobile phone operator Telecel-Comunicacoes Pessoais was 7,950 escudos per share, Lisbon bourse said.

Demand in the flotation comfortably exceeded the available supply of shares in both the public offer for sale (OPV) and the domestic and international institutional sale, sources involved in the process said.
Telecel, one of two mobile phone operators in the domestic market, is offering a 35.6 percent stake of its 21.5 billion escudos capital, that is 7.645 million shares.
This stake could rise to 39.11 percent including a "green shoe" provision, whereby additional shares may be allocated to institutional investors if demand is very heavy.
Shares in the OPV are destined for Telecel employees, clients, distributors and the general public.
